A free financial assistance app for people who are unbanked or underbanked. BankGuard is not a bank and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any bank.
Every person, bank, account, merchant and amount in this app is fictional.

Pending-charge cancellation and transaction recovery use a simulated partner bank that answers by fixed rules. BankGuard has no real bank integration or partnership, and real outcomes would depend on eligibility and the bank\'s approval.

The proposed recovery fee is 5% of your balance before the charge, shown before you agree and charged only if a recovery is confirmed. It\'s a prototype business model that needs legal, payments and bank-partnership review. For bank fees, you send any waiver request yourself and your bank decides.
Letters are drafted from a template you review and edit. AI-drafted letters are planned for a later version and would still need your review.
Forecasts and savings figures are estimates based on simple, visible rules. They aren\'t financial advice or a guarantee.
This demo doesn\'t send anything you enter anywhere. Demo progress is cleared when the app is fully closed. Copying or sharing a letter only happens when you choose to.

resources.string: Every overdraft-free day counts. Finish a day with your balance at $0.00 or above to earn your first star.
Every achievement unlocked. Keep it going!
You earn one star for each completed day your available balance stays at $0.00 or above. Predicted dips don\'t count against you; only a balance that actually goes negative does.
One difficult day doesn\'t erase your progress.
If a charge overdraws your account and BankGuard later recovers it, that day still counts as an overdraft day. Recovering money doesn\'t rewrite what happened.

Ends the simulated day and starts the next one. The day is judged on the lowest available balance seen during it, so a star is earned only if the balance never went below $0.00. Pressing this doesn\'t award anything by itself, and a live version wouldn\'t have it.
The six days before the demo starts are sample balance history. Stars aren\'t money and can\'t be redeemed.
